Third-party AI components bundled with BISCS India tools
=========================================================

MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.14 (mediapipe/), and models selfie_multiclass_256x256,
selfie_segmenter, magic_touch, blaze_face_short_range (models/)
  Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
  https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe  https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  selfie_multiclass_256x256.tflite is stored in two parts (.part0, .part1) that are
  concatenated byte-for-byte in the browser.

TensorFlow.js 4.20.0 (upscaler/tf.min.js)
  Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

UpscalerJS 1.0.0-beta.19 and @upscalerjs/esrgan-medium 1.0.0-beta.13 (upscaler/)
